lines.text: Tears stream down twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse Harper's face as she stares at an unpaid bill for her seventeen-year-old sister Mia's emergency heart surgery.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Please, Mia needs this heart surgery tonight or she will not survive!
A rugged man in oil-stained coveralls steps forward and places a cashier's check on the hospital counter.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: I am paying for Mia's surgery in full right now.
Thirty-two-year-old mechanic Cole Hayes wipes grease off his hands as Harper follows him into the small garage.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You are just a night-shift mechanic, Cole, how do you have one hundred thousand dollars for my sister?

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: My condition is simple: sign a one-year contract marriage with me tonight, and the hospital operates immediately.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: A contract marriage with a stranger just to save Mia's life?
Cole slides a signed legal marriage document across the workbench toward her.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Sign it, Harper, or I walk away and your sister loses her chance.
Harper signs the marriage contract with shaking hands as seventeen-year-old Mia is rolled into the operating room.
Cole secretly glances at his phone screen displaying a message from Whitmore Shipping regarding his hidden CEO status.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Your sister is safe now, wife.
High heels clack against the tile floor as Cole's wealthy stepmother Diane Whitmore enters with her twenty-nine-year-old son Jake.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: What is a pathetic mechanic like you doing marrying a broke nurse in public?
